MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick feels worth trying because convenient TV streaming connects with my HDMI cable and Raspberry Pi entertainment setup.",
    "That streaming option recognizes a plausible entertainment interest alongside my practical computer accessory purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The security cameras and doorbell solve a home monitoring problem I haven't shown a need for; buying electronics accessories doesn't make those useful to me now.",
    "The Echo speakers, smart displays, and smart plug depend on wanting voice assistance or home automation, while my recent purchases support wired networking and an organized computer workspace.",
    "The Fire tablets offer additional portable screens without a clear task for them; my Kindle purchase alone doesn't establish that I want another entertainment device."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into a broad interest in connected home devices.",
    "My Kindle purchase seems to carry too much weight toward other Amazon devices, even when they serve different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My Ethernet adapter and cables point toward practical connectivity needs, where the connection type and intended device matter more than simply being electronic.",
    "My headphone mount, cable organizers, and electric duster suggest that improving and maintaining my existing setup matters to me.",
    "My Raspberry Pi, matching case, and power supply show purchases that work together for a specific project; a useful next choice should have a clear role in that setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations caught a plausible streaming interest but mostly mistook my practical computer and Raspberry Pi projects for a desire to build an Alexa-connected home."
}
